# Draw & Guess

> Draw & Guess is a live multiplayer drawing game where friends race an AI challenger named FastH3.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://drawguess.app/): Create or join a Draw & Guess room.
- [Terms](https://drawguess.app/terms): Service and fair-play terms.
- [Privacy](https://drawguess.app/privacy): Data, voice, whiteboard, AI, and analytics practices.

## How the game works

- Players draw together on a synchronized Agora Interactive Whiteboard.
- Human players submit guesses in real time and may optionally use Agora RTC voice chat.
- When invited, FastH3 analyzes drawing snapshots and submits its own guesses.
- An AI win counts only when FastH3 both guesses correctly and generates matching visual proof that passes verification.

## Technology

- Agora RTC provides optional realtime voice.
- Agora Interactive Whiteboard synchronizes drawings between players.
- An OpenAI vision model interprets drawing snapshots and verifies AI proof.
- Reactor FastH3 generates the visual proof required for the AI challenger to win.

## Crawling guidance

Public marketing and legal pages may be indexed. Room URLs contain ephemeral live-game state and should not be indexed. API routes are application endpoints rather than public documentation.
